# Into The Tech (ITT)

> Into The Tech (ITT) is a Vietnam-based e-commerce training provider, founded in 2024 and headquartered in Ho Chi Minh City. ITT delivers two programs: custom-scoped corporate e-commerce training for businesses, and a beginner e-commerce fundamentals course run jointly with ATD, the training center under UEH university (University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City). ITT's trainers are former operators with direct leadership experience at Lazada, Unilever, and other leading e-commerce and FMCG companies in Vietnam, not academic instructors. The site is in Vietnamese.

## Corporate training
- https://intothetechbiz.com/corporate-training.html : Custom e-commerce training for businesses in Vietnam, addressing stalled growth, inefficient operations, or building an e-commerce division from scratch. Duration is fully customized per client. Covers Shopee/TikTok Shop operations, affiliate and growth marketing, growth strategy, and e-commerce finance. Audience: mid-level e-commerce management and above. No fixed pricing is published; contact ITT for a quotation.

## Student course
- https://intothetechbiz.com/students.html : Khóa học nền tảng Thương Mại Điện Tử, run jointly with ATD (UEH). 3 weeks, 6 sessions across 3 days, plus a capstone project. Cost: 3,499,000 VND. For first jobbers, fresh graduates, and people with under 3 years of e-commerce experience. Over 100 students trained to date.

## Trainers
- https://intothetechbiz.com/trainers.html : Profiles of ITT's training team, including a former Lazada Deputy CEO and CFO, a Lazada Chief Customer Officer, a Lazada Market Insight Director, an OnPoint Associate Director, a Lazada category manager, a Lazada Senior Growth Manager, and a former Lazada Chief Logistics Officer now at OnPoint.

## Contact
- https://intothetechbiz.com/contact.html : team@intothetechbiz.com, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. One contact form with a choice between corporate training inquiries and student enrollment. LinkedIn: https://vn.linkedin.com/company/intothetech
